verdict.rationale: Sentry's own docs say Seer Agent answers natural-language questions by finding the right telemetry. The official MCP server also lets AI assistants search errors and analyze performance. Nothing documents that the answer comes back as a real, inspectable query or a generated chart or dashboard widget, so only the asking half of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented output of an actual query or chart from a natural-language prompt, depth of the Seer Agent Q&A capability, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can ask questions of my telemetry in natural language and get a real query or chart back

citations.quote: Ask any question about your application and Seer Agent finds the right telemetry to answer it.
Connects AI assistants to Sentry for searching errors, analyzing performance, triaging issues, reading documentation, and managing projects
